title: Vinh Hiển Không Phai / Glory No Dey Fade
lyrics:
Verse 1
Từ sáng sớm cho đến tối I go sing
Vinh hiển của Chúa dey make me king
Không power of darkness fit resist
Niềm vui của Ngài dey always persist
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
Verse 2
Lời chứng của tôi dey loud ngoài phố
Với Giê-xu, đời tôi complete o
Thiên sứ dey join bài ca melody
Heaven and earth dey sing in harmony
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
Verse 3
Phép lạ dey follow every đường
Ơn phước dey fill hai bàn tay strong
When I shout lớn “Ha-lê-lu-gia eh!”
Enemies run scatter, dem fade away
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
Verse 4
Mọi quốc gia go bow before King
Mọi ngôn ngữ go rise và sing
Forever Yesu, tôi hát praise
Saviour reign, quyền năng always
Chorus
Vinh hiển không phai, Yesu reign forever
Quyền năng no dey shake, tình yêu Ngài fail never
Hãy nhảy múa và celebrate, chiến thắng everyday
Vinh hiển không phai, vinh hiển không phai
english:
Verse 1
From early morning until night I will sing.
The Lord’s glory makes me a king.
No power of darkness can stand against it.
His joy endures.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.

Verse 2
My testimony rings out in the street.
With Jesus my life is complete.
Angels join the melody.
Heaven and earth sing in harmony.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.

Verse 3
Miracles follow me on every road.
Blessings fill both my strong hands.
When I shout aloud, “Hallelujah!”
My enemies scatter and fade away.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.

Verse 4
Every nation will bow before the King.
Every tongue will rise in song.
Jesus, forever I will sing Your praise.
The Savior reigns, forever in power.

Chorus
His glory never fades. Jesus reigns forever.
His power cannot be shaken. His love never fails.
Dance and celebrate victory every day.
His glory never fades. His glory never fades.
description: From dawn to dusk, a singer carries the news of God’s unfading glory into the streets. Vietnamese and Nigerian Pidgin meet in a chorus that calls every nation to dance.

title: Victory Is Sure
lyrics:
Verse 1
मसीह में विजय है पक्की
उसने युद्ध जीत लिया
गाओ, बजाओ, ऊँची आवाज़ उठाओ
सारे मन से चिल्लाओ
Chorus
आवाज़: विजय
उत्तर: विजय
आवाज़: प्रभु में
उत्तर: प्रभु में
नाचो और उसकी स्तुति करो
सदैव सदा
Verse 2
हर परीक्षा बदलती है खुशी में
यीशु राह बना देता है
गाओ और चिल्लाओ, युद्ध हुआ खत्म
आज ही उत्सव मनाओ
Chorus
आवाज़: विजय
उत्तर: विजय
आवाज़: प्रभु में
उत्तर: प्रभु में
नाचो और उसकी स्तुति करो
सदैव सदा
Verse 3
अपना झंडा ऊँचा उठाओ
यीशु है राजा
उसमें हमारी विजय है
लोग सब गाएँ
Chorus
आवाज़: विजय
उत्तर: विजय
आवाज़: प्रभु में
उत्तर: प्रभु में
नाचो और उसकी स्तुति करो
सदैव सदा
english:
Verse 1
In Christ, victory is sure.
He has won the battle.
Sing, play your instruments, raise your voices.
Shout with all your heart.

Chorus
Leader: Victory!
Response: Victory!
Leader: In the Lord!
Response: In the Lord!
Dance and praise Him
forever and ever.

Verse 2
Every trial turns into joy.
Jesus makes a way.
Sing and shout! The battle is over.
Celebrate today.

Chorus
Leader: Victory!
Response: Victory!
Leader: In the Lord!
Response: In the Lord!
Dance and praise Him
forever and ever.

Verse 3
Raise your banner high.
Jesus is King.
In Him we have victory.
Let everyone sing.

Chorus
Leader: Victory!
Response: Victory!
Leader: In the Lord!
Response: In the Lord!
Dance and praise Him
forever and ever.
description: A Hindi call-and-response song about Christ’s victory. One voice calls out and the congregation answers before everyone joins in praise.

title: Ninainua Sauti Yangu / Lift My Voice
lyrics:
Verse 1
Nikikumbuka jinsi You don bring me far
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance freely par
Rehema zako dey cover kichwa changu
Na nguvu zako dey raise me kutoka shimo
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Verse 2
Nani fit kuzuia nuru ya Mungu wangu?
Who fit close njia ya Bwana wangu?
Sherehe dey fill moyo wangu kabisa
Na jubilation dey turn am to wimbo
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Verse 3
When I praise, mbingu dey shake
When I dance, minyororo dey break
Popote I go, Roho Wako flow
Kila nafsi hupokea, joy go show
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Verse 4
Mataifa yote go sing pamoja
Sauti za watu, both weak and stronger
Forever Yesu, Mfalme wa milele
Glory kwa Mungu, tena we sing
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
Chorus
Ninainua sauti yangu, I dance for Yesu
Ninainua mikono yangu, I shout haleluya
Ninainua wimbo wangu, I praise forever
Ninainua sauti yangu, ninainua sauti yangu
english:
Verse 1
When I remember how far You have brought me,
I lift my voice and dance freely.
Your mercy covers my head,
and Your strength lifts me out of the pit.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Verse 2
Who can stop the light of my God?
Who can close the way of my Lord?
Celebration fills my whole heart,
and rejoicing turns it into a song.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Verse 3
When I praise, the heavens shake.
When I dance, chains break.
Wherever I go, Your Spirit flows.
Every soul receives, and joy shines through.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Verse 4
All nations will sing together.
Hear the voices of the weak and the strong.
Jesus forever, King everlasting!
Glory to God! Again we sing.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.

Chorus
I lift my voice and dance for Jesus.
I lift my hands and shout hallelujah.
I raise my song and praise You forever.
I lift my voice. I lift my voice.
description: A singer remembers being lifted from the pit and answers with raised hands. Swahili and Nigerian Pidgin carry the invitation to sing together.

title: ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ / Yesu Meri Agg / Jesus My Fire
lyrics:
ਬੰਦ 1 (Verse 1)
ਜਿੱਥੇ ਵੀ ਜਾਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਰੋਸ਼ਨੀ ਚਮਕਦੀ
ਤੂੰ ਗ਼ਮ ਨੂੰ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਾਬ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ
ਜ਼ੰਜੀਰਾਂ ਟੁੱਟਦੀਆਂ ਜਦੋਂ ਮੈਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਪੁਕਾਰਾਂ
ਤੇਰੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੈ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਸ਼ਰਮ ਨਹੀਂ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
ਬੰਦ 2 (Verse 2)
ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਤੂਫ਼ਾਨ ਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਲੰਘਾਉਂਦਾ
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਜ਼ਿੰਦਗੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ
ਹਨੇਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਕੀਮਤੀ ਰੌਸ਼ਨੀ ਵਿੱਚ
ਤੇਰੇ ਆਤਮਾ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੱਚ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੁੰਦਾ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
ਬੰਦ 3 (Verse 3)
ਬਰਕਤਾਂ ਹਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਹਨ
ਤੇਰੀ ਰਹਿਮਤ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਢੱਕਦੀ ਹੈ
ਕੌਣ ਰੋਕ ਸਕਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਦਿਲ ਦਾ ਗੀਤ?
ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਰਦਾ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
ਬੰਦ 4 (Verse 4)
ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਸ਼ਟਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੀਤ ਸੁਣਣਗੇ
ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਨੱਚਣਗੇ
ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਯਿਸੂ ਨੂੰ ਗਾਵਾਂਗਾ
ਸਦੀਵੀ ਰਾਜਾ, ਤੂੰ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਨਾਲ ਰਾਜ ਕਰਦਾ
ਰਿਫਰੈਨ (Chorus)
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਤੂੰ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉੱਚਾ ਚੁੱਕਦਾ
ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਾਂ ਫਟਦੀਆਂ, ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਖ਼ਾਹਿਸ਼
ਫਤਿਹ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੱਕਦੀ
ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ, ਯਿਸੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਅੱਗ
english:
Verse 1
Wherever I go, Your light shines.
You turn sorrow into the wine of joy.
Chains break when I call Your name.
Your glory is with me. I feel no shame.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.

Verse 2
You lead me through the storm.
You make my life complete.
From darkness into precious light,
with Your Spirit my dance begins.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.

Verse 3
Blessings are with me every day.
Your mercy covers me.
Who can stop the song in my heart?
You bring my story to completion.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.

Verse 4
All nations will hear my song.
All peoples will dance together.
I will sing to Jesus forever.
Eternal King, You reign in splendor.

Chorus
Jesus, my fire, You lift me high.
My praises burst forth. You are my heart’s desire.
Victory is sure. My joy never grows weary.
Jesus, my fire. Jesus, my fire.
description: In this Punjabi worship song, sorrow becomes the wine of joy. The singer calls on Jesus through the storm and looks forward to the nations dancing together.
